name: Service Level (SLA)
description: Share of requests completed within the agreed service level.

name: Quality Score
description: Audit points achieved as a share of points possible.

name: Average Handle Time
description: Average minutes spent handling one contact.

name: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
description: Satisfied survey responses as a share of all responses.

name: First Contact Resolution
description: Contacts resolved without a repeat contact.

name: Backlog (days of work)
description: Open items at end of day divided by daily incoming volume.

name: Monthly Attrition
description: Leavers as a share of average headcount in the month.

name: Cost per Transaction
description: Total operating cost divided by transactions completed (INR).
